name: Rival Species
summary: In the far distant future of the 40th millennium behind the stars there is only war. Enter the universe of WARHAMMER 40,000 and play a mighty warrior for one out of an ever growing list of rival species. A large PvP team multiplayer mod for Half-Life that plays similary to Battlefield/Battlefront, based on the Game's Workshop property. Eventually Exterminatus, A sequel for the Source Engine would be made

name: Hearts of Chaos
summary: RPG veteran Warfare Studios (Vagrant Hearts, Ashes of Immortality, Shining Plume) is back with a new tale in this exciting, story-driven RPG.

name: Power Guy World
summary: Power Guy World is a 30 exit SMW romhack created by LucasMegaStriker as a tribute to the Vtuber "Power Guy".

name: Born for the Light: Wavelength Radiant Collapse
summary: Endless world. Endless sky. Endless light. Will the shadows be cast upon all Children dwelling on the Treetops? Regardless, I spread my prosthetic wings, taking a leap of faith.

name: Dune Buggy
summary: Dune Buggy is a 2D single player flash racing game. It has a total of 15 levels that the player must make their way through by driving the dune buggy from one end to the other, while avoiding hazards and overcoming obstacles such as high jumps.

name: Ace wo Nerae!
summary: A tennis game for the Super Famicom based on the 1970s manga and anime of the same name.

name: The Deal
summary: A Doom II WAD.

name: Nightmare Kart: The Old Karts
summary: An upcoming free expansion to Nightmare Kart with a brand new mini-campaign, racers, karts, tracks, power-ups, and game modes.

name: Five Shifts at Zlata's
summary: Five Shifts at Zlata's is an atmospheric horror night-shift simulator where you play as a security mechanic in a family restaurant hiding dark secrets. Monitor cameras, manage power, restart the generator, and keep the animatronics-mascots away. Survive five shifts… if you can.

name: Safecracker
summary:
As the name implies, this game is all about cracking safes. Within an eccentric millionaire's luxurious mansion, thirty-five safes in all sizes, shapes and colors are hidden. As an applicant for the position of Security Development Chief, you must prove your worthiness by locating and opening every one of the mansion's safes without getting caught by security.

Safecracker is a puzzle game within a graphical setting. Exercise your brain cells and challenge your powers of logic and deduction while solving its mind-bending puzzles. Are you good enough to crack the Granddaddy of all safes?

name: BanG Dream! Girls Band Party! for Nintendo Switch
summary:
Popular rhythm game in Japan!
Tap to the rhythm of over 200 songs to choose from.
Play both original and cover songs from popular J-Pop artists and anime songs!
Play your favorite songs on a level of difficulty that suits you!

name: Yokai Dungeon
summary: Yokai have just interrupted the lantern festival, it's up to Tanuki and his friends to save the day. Push blocks to crush the pesky yokai, explore randomly generated dungeons, and dive into beatiful Japanese folklore.

name: Electro Havoc
summary: Electro Havoc: A retro twin-stick shooter set in a neon-charged battleground where you'll face waves of geometric foes. Lure more enemies into debris fields to trigger chain reactions, and grab power-ups to boost your multipliers.

name: Suna no Embrace: Eden no Sato no Never
summary: A RPG set in a desert fantasy world where water is the most valued resource.

name: Pica
summary: This is a casual jigsaw puzzle game. All you need to do is use the mouse to drag the pieces to the correct positions, and when you complete the puzzle and form a complete picture, you can unlock the picture gallery.

name: Umineko: Ougon Musou Kyoku - Cross
summary:
A tag-team fighting game based around the Umineko no Naku Koro ni universe of visual novels, Cross is the followup to 2010's Ougon Musou Kyoku.

In this version George, Jessica, and Rosa from the Ushiromiya family join the fray.

name: Guitar Hero Live
platforms: PlayStation 3, PlayStation 4, iOS, Wii U, Xbox 360, Xbox One
summary: Guitar Hero Live is a music game that served as a reboot of the Guitar Hero franchise, being the first new entry in the series since Warriors of Rock in 2010. Guitar Hero Live introduced major changes to the core gameplay and experience of the Guitar Hero franchise, including a revamped guitar controller with a new, 6-button layout, a new in-game presentation style that utilizes full motion video, simulating a real-world concert setting from the perspective of the guitarist, and a new Guitar Hero TV mode to encompass multiplayer and curated playlists in the style of television music channels.

name: Cloud Cutter
summary: Cloud Cutter brings you classic arcade shoot ‘em up gameplay in top notch graphics. Enjoy intense fast-paced explosive action full of epic destruction, arcade style power-ups, lasers and of course huge multi-stage boss fights.

name: Merge Games Horror Bundle
summary: What do dark Nordic fables, intergalactic cruises and Lovecraftian gore all have in common? Gruesome, gory and ghoulish monsters! Dive into the horror-themed worlds of Bramble: The Mountain King, Morbid: The Seven Acolytes and Slaycation Paradise - if you dare!

name: Multi Quiz
summary: A great quiz to play alone, with your family or friends! Test your knowledge with this exceptional Multi Quiz game. Our quiz offers not only challenging facts but also funny and interesting knowledge.

name: Clash of Weirdos: Card Carnage
platforms: Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch
summary: Unleash chaos with crazy cards in epic weirdo battles!

name: Fight,to the last
summary: This is a 2D dungeon rogue shooting game. Players can kill enemies to stick a variety of dropped weapons, free combination, through a variety of different combinations to define their own attack mode.

name: Football Manager Touch 2016
platforms: Linux, Android, PC (Microsoft Windows), iOS, Mac
summary: Football Manager Touch 2016 is a streamlined football management simulation designed for faster play on tablets and computers. It features over 130 real leagues, cross-save compatibility between devices, and the series’ 3D match engine. New additions include Create-a-Club mode, Prozone match analysis, expanded tactical options, and various unlockables, offering a more accessible alternative to the full Football Manager experience.

name: Street Vendor Simulator
summary: Buy, sell, and earn big on the city streets by selling water.

name: DCS World: NS 430 Navigation System for SA342 Gazelle by Eagle Dynamics, Polychop Simulations
summary: The NS 430 for the SA342 Gazelle module integrates the NS 430 panel directly into the SA342 Gazelle cockpit (not as a pop-up display).

name: Impossible Stunts
summary: Prepare for an adrenaline-pumping experience in this racing game of Impossible Stunts!

name: Caravan Shooting Collection
summary:
Caravan Shooting Collection is a 1995 Super Famicom compilation of classic shoot 'em up games from 1985 to 1987 that were originally released on the Nintendo Entertainment System.

The games include the 1985 Famicom port of Star Force (the Arcade version was originally created by Tecmo, but the home port was developed by Hudson), 1986's Star Soldier and 1987's Hector (a.k.a. Starship Hector).

All three of these games were the subjects of the Hudson All-Japan Caravan Festival, which for a long time hosted a new Hudson shoot 'em up every year and traveled around Japan with competitors in different prefectures attempting to earn the highest scores. The game would then be available for sale shortly before or after the competition, which helped raise its profile.

name: Detective Solitaire: The Ghost Agency 2
summary: Do you like solitaire games? Do you like to solve mysterious riddles, examine clues and catch dangerous criminals, or maybe you have always dreamed of joining the Ghost Agency? Then this game will not leave you indifferent!

name: E-Snake
summary:
A phone classic, brought to the E-Reader!

E-Snake contains many levels, modes, secrets and its own achievements!

name: Eonwar
summary: Comfortably paced, match-based strategy with a PvE twist, contrasted with intense physics-based combat. Take direct control of tanks, infantry and ships across space and planetside. Manage your powerful deck of commanders and battle with up to 6 players! Will you rule or unite Omega Centauri?

name: Dance Break Dance
summary: In Dance Break Dance, it's all about quick reflexes and perfect timing. Spin the crank to make your adorable dancer bust out wild moves, but be sure to stop in time! The faster you crank, the crazier the dance, and the more points you score. Can you keep up with the rhythm and become the cutest dance master?

name: Angkor: Beginnings
summary: Angkor: Beginnings is a highly re-playable fantasy Match 3 with modern design and aesthetics. The game tells the story of a family trapped on an island with an active volcano. The game also includes mini games and puzzles for variety and extra fun!

name: Ether Vapor Remaster
summary:
All hope seems to be lost for the country of Lydia in their war against Caldea, which has a huge advantage in numbers and technology. Into the midst of this war flies an unknown pilot in a prototype fighter... His agenda and the secret to the his awesome firepower will be revealed as he takes on overwhelming numbers of enemy fighters and massive bosses to reach his final objective. 
 
Ether Vapor Remaster is a cinematic 3D arcade shooter and visual treat from developer Edelweiss. Explosions, lasers, ships and backgrounds are breathtakingly rendered. The dynamic camera uses vertical, horizontal and cinematic chase cam views to switch up the action and highlight the drama. Use multi-lock-on to shoot tens of missiles at a time and even blow up an entire battleship in the challenging Bonus Zones.

name: Kitten Tales
summary: Embark on an exciting quest in Kitten Tales, solve puzzles to find your mother in story mode, and challenge up to 10 players in online races and multiplayer challenges. Do you have what it takes to be the bravest cat?

name: Symble
summary: A code-cracking logic game, where players must guess a secret five letter word. Each guess reveals a set of three mystery symbols, and players must use their guesses to determine what each symbol represents in order to decode the secret word.

name: Prison Escape Simulator: Dig Out
summary: Too long in this prison, time to get out of here. Pull the carpet and start digging with a teaspoon. Watch out for the guard, sell him the junk you find. Trade toilet paper with the prisoners. Get better items and improve your stats. Expand the tunnel, use glow sticks and dynamite. Will you escape?

name: Streamers Company Tycoon
summary: First online streamer agency in this country! A new company! Now face the whole country and recruit company manager!

name: Mad Max
platforms: PlayStation 4, Linux, PC (Microsoft Windows), Mac, Xbox One
summary:
In Mad Max, the player takes on the role of titular character Mad Max; a dangerous melee fighter and can use his attacks to kill almost anyone. His weapon of choice is his shotgun. He is assisted by another man called Chumbucket. Chum mainly works with Max to build and upgrade the Magnum Opus vehicle.

Mad Max will feature a variety of weapons which Max can use to defeat enemies. Though the shotgun is Max's weapon of choice, ammo is scarce, and so melee options are the smarter way to go. The 'thunderstick' is an explosive weapon that can be lanced into an enemy's chest, crackling like a lit dynamite fuse before blowing the victim to smithereens. The Harpoon is also one of Max's favorite weapon though it can only be used in-vehicle with Chum riding along. Max's Magnum Opus can be combined with a speedy V12 engine and powerful ramming ability to destroy enemies's vehicles and weaponry. When simultaneously driving and aiming, the game enters slow-motion and allows you to toggle between targets. Not much is known about the vehicular combat and its features.

Mad Max will feature crafting system which can be used to craft new weapons and tools. Max's garage can also be used to change and modify the car's engines, chassis, wheels, body works including paint treatment and the “shell” of the auto-mobile and the car’s weight and attributes update accordingly. Max can also be upgraded though it's plans hasn't fully been implemented.

Many choices are given in the game, such as, either playing silently or aggressively. Max can also get guidance from Chum about how he can complete his objectives strategically. However, its largely up to the player how he can complete the objectives.

name: Alleykat
summary:
Alleykat is a vertically-scrolling racer with elements of a shoot-em up game.

The player, a speeder pilot, strives to become the Alleykat Champion by competing in eight space stadiums scattered around the galaxy. Different races like demolition derbies, time-trials, endurance epics and others feature all kinds of obstacles like rocks, pillars, bridges and hard walls, and several types of enemies race along.

The game also features a cooperative two-player-mode.

name: Wrecking Crew
platforms: Family Computer Disk System, Nintendo 3DS, Wii, Family Computer, Wii U, Game Boy Advance, Nintendo Entertainment System
summary: Wrecking Crew is a platform action game for one or two players. The player controls Mario (Player 2 as Luigi) working on a demolition site. The goal is to break down all of the stone walls on each stage. The game features a custom level maker, where players can make their own Wrecking Crew levels. The game had the ability to save those custom levels. However, the required peripherals (the keyboard and Data Recorder accessories) were released only in Japan.

name: DWK 5: Hinter dem Horizont
summary:
DWK 5: Hinter dem Horizont is a traditional point & click adventure game based on the movie Die wilden Kerle 5: Hinter dem Horizont. The young soccer players Leon, Vanessa, Maxi and Raban are practising in the woods - but suddenly Leon disappears. Of course his friends search for him and suddenly arrive in the land of vampires...

The player alternately takes the control of the four protagonists and solves item based puzzles. To do so he explores his surroundings, takes everything he finds, talks with people and combines items with each other. In each scene the player can instantly switch between day and night which alters the persons he meet and the items he can interact with. When stuck the player has access to a hint system.

name: Coastline to Atmosphere
summary:
Coastline to Atmosphere is a big Single Player Modification for Half-Life 2. It's actually 15 Single Player maps with a story that links them together.

Leon Stephan Brinkmann took about 1 year to create this. He's done an excelent job to create this. With new models, such as a Keycard model, Tree models, a new shiny metal texture. And new sounds from the games Medal of Honor, Call of Duty, Soldier of Fortune 2, Max Payne 2, Cold Winter and a whole lot of ambient sounds.

name: Elliot
platforms: PlayStation 4, PC (Microsoft Windows), Xbox One, Nintendo Switch
summary: Elliot is a colourful 2D platformer inspired by 16-bit classics, with a touch of hardcore. Don't be misled by appearances: it's a colorful game, but really it's technicolor hell!

name: Sonic Uprising
summary: SONIC UPRISING is a 2D side-scrolling platform fan project led by bennascar and Team Giga-Drive. Uprising is inspired by the classic formula from the Mega Drive Era of Sonic the Hedgehog, expanding it by taking elements from various other titles in the series. The project's goal is to create a story inspired by SEGA's Sonic Forces, while also being able to tell a narrative that goes far beyond a simple reboot.

name: Death of the Reprobate
summary: Explore a world built from the luscious landscapes, turbulent townscapes and preposterous portraits of real Renaissance paintings. Death of the Reprobate is a Rabelaisian point and click adventure from the creator of Four Last Things and The Procession to Calvary.

name: Wizardry 8
summary:
The universe is in the throes of violent upheaval and change. Vast and mysterious forces are preparing for the final confrontation. A small group of heroes from distant lands must plunge into the heart of the maelstrom, to uncover long-forgotten secrets, and bring about a new era. Should they succeed, they will gain the powers of the gods themselves. If they fail, countless worlds will fall into the grip of darkness.

Wizardry 8 raises the standard for fantasy role-playing with a vengeance. Prepare yourself for a new level of excitement, immersiveness and depth that made role-playing games one of the best-selling, best-loved genres of all time.

Prepare to experience the culmination of a prestigious RPG series. Enter a vast world of intrigue and wonder. Unravel a gripping, non-linear storyline. Battle your way to victory using your swords, your magic, and your wits. Compete with rivals or align with allies as you struggle to ascend to the Cosmic Circle. Take the battle to the dreaded Dark Savant in Wizardry 8, the phenomenal conclusion to the Dark Savant trilogy, one of the most extensive and challenging stories ever told in classic role-playing games!

name: Ultimate Custom Night
summary:
Welcome to the ultimate FNAF mashup, where you will once again be trapped alone in an office fending off killer animatronics! Featuring 50 selectable animatronic characters spanning seven Five Nights at Freddy's games, the options for customization are nearly endless. Mix and match any assortment of characters that you like, set their difficulty from 0-20, then jump right into the action! From your office desk, you will need to manage two side doors, two vents, as well as two air hoses, all of which lead directly into your office.

This time you will have to master other tools as well if you want to complete the ultimate challenges, tools such as the heater, A/C, a global music box, a power generator, and more. As if all of that weren't enough, you'll also need to set up laser traps in the vents, collect Faz-Coins, purchase items from the prize counter, and as always, keep a close eye on not one, but two, Pirate Cove curtains!
